PIT.head: A slightly uphill night for the Penguins
PIT.body: Even though Pittsburgh has home-ice advantage, the Penguins are on the second night of a back-to-back. On top of that, Dallas has been out-chancing opponents lately. The Penguins’ best way to tip it is getting good looks.

DAL.head: The Stars have a slight edge
DAL.body: Even though Pittsburgh has home-ice advantage, the Penguins are on the second night of a back-to-back. On top of that, Dallas has been out-chancing opponents lately. The Penguins can still swing it if they get good looks.

story.head: The matchup inside the matchup
paras: The Penguins are winless in three (0-2-1). The Stars have won two in a row, the last a 4-0 rout of Buffalo.

It’s strength against strength: the Stars are one of the league’s best for the power play, but the Penguins are near the top at the penalty kill. The Stars make their shots count, and the Pens allow dangerous ones.
